title: Article 382 — Provisional Legislatures for States in Part A (Omitted)

content.overview: Article 382 provided for provisional Legislatures for States in Part A of the First Schedule. Omitted by the Constitution (Seventh Amendment) Act, 1956 (w.e.f. 1-11-1956). Spent transitional provision.
content.glance: Art 382 omitted by 7th Amendment 1956 (w.e.f. 1-11-1956). Provisional Part A Legislatures — spent.
content.study: Part of the 379–391 transitional block. Omitted by 7th Amendment, 1956 (w.e.f. 1-11-1956).

questionsAndAnswers.question: Status of Article 382?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Omitted by the 7th Amendment, 1956 (w.e.f. 1-11-1956). Spent transitional provision.
